title.narrative: WOMEN'S RIGHTS ARE HUMAN RIGHTS! Enhancing Women's Rights through strengthening the Gender Advisors in Arab local authorities

description.narrative:
Impact: Improved perception of human rights by Israeli public and increased human rights accountability at the domestic level.

Outcomes:

1)     The work of Gender Advisors in Arab Local Authorities is enabled as mandated by the Israeli legislation: GA Law 2000

Gender Advisors are recognized among Arab Local Authorities, and effectively advocate for gender mainstreaming and a rights-based approach.
